name: Ricardo Barbosa
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began in his late teens, volunteering at local karting events in São Paulo. He quickly found himself drawn to the intricate logistics required to keep a racing team running smoothly. After securing a degree in Business Administration, Ricardo worked his way up through several smaller racing outfits before joining CRG Racing Team five years ago. He prides himself on his meticulous planning and ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise, ensuring that the team's equipment and personnel are always where they need to be, when they need to be there.

His approach to logistics is rooted in a combination of traditional methods and a keen awareness of technological advancements. While he values proven strategies, he's always looking for innovative ways to streamline processes and improve efficiency. Ricardo is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that has earned him the respect of his colleagues. He's committed to ensuring CRG team has all the resources to win.

Ricardo's distinctive attention to detail is what sets him apart. He keeps detailed records of every shipment, every maintenance schedule, and every contingency plan. This meticulousness ensures that CRG Racing Team is always prepared for any eventuality, both on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and reminders.
Insists on using a specific brand of Brazilian coffee in the team's paddock.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
